rationale: tv_iterative_supervised-claude-agentic: tv_step_init=0.0001, val_n=12, rationale=iter-12 RE-DISPATCH (toward 20): outer optimiser lr 5e-3->1e-2 at the lambda_init=0.02 PEAK (iter-11 0.8631 best; lambda bracketed 0.01=0.860, 0.05=0.720). HYPOTHESIS: the 0.863 plateau is optimisation-limited, not structural - the 20 step/lambda scalars are under-converged at epochs=20 (the iter-8->9 jump 0.816->0.860 came from training longer). The prior iter-12 tested this via epochs 20->28 but that job (764828) RAN 59 MIN AND TIMED OUT at the 1h sbatch wall WITHOUT recording. epochs=20 already costs ~47.3 min (iter-11 elapsed 2838.7s), so I CANNOT add epochs and stay under the wall. Instead I let the scalars travel further per epoch via a 2x outer lr, keeping epochs=20 (fits the wall). BUDGET CUT to fit ~50min wall: val_n 20->12 (per-sample-ps chunk=1 val pass) buys ~3 min margin -> wall estimate ~44 min., train_n=200, epochs=20, tv_lambda_init=0.02, lr=0.01
